title: WPSS/1758/2007 of PRAKASH SINGH NEGI Vs REGISTRAR GENERAL HIGH COURT and ANR.

paras.text:
WPSS No.1758/2007
Honíble Dharam Veer, J.
(Withdrawal Application No.8447/2008)
Sri Nagesh Aggarwal, Advocate holding brief of Sri Amish
Tiwari, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Sri H.M. Raturi, learned Standing Counsel for the State.
Perused the application supported by an affidavit. Grounds
stated in the affidavit are satisfactory to allow the application.
Accordingly, the Withdrawal Application No.8447/2008 is allowed.
Consequently, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
 (D.V.,J.)
 17.02.09
